print.notes: Print original is a photographic reproduction of a real book's cover/title/copyright/contents page (references/_gemini/gold-2-A/page-076.png), not encoded as running text anywhere in the source .txt. Neither independent transcription run modelled it into print.blocks (both left print.blocks empty); this reconciliation viewed the page image directly to confirm the braille.lines transcription and the sample's own title/rule citation, but likewise leaves print.blocks empty -- building a faithful print.blocks model of a photographed book cover is out of this reconciliation's scope (reconciling two existing transcription runs), not a disagreement between them to resolve.

resolution: braille.lines: A and B agree on content; A's version (kept here) retains the source's own leading/internal/trailing blank braille lines verbatim (confirmed by direct re-derivation from source-lines-1390-2934.txt), matching this gold corpus's established convention (see e.g. tests/gold/bana-formats-2016/section-5's own U+2800-filler-line handling); B's version silently strips those blank lines. illustrates.quote: A's rule text was verbatim-correct but scoped to the whole lettered rule (plus, in some files, a stray page-footer line glued in by the extraction) rather than the specific numbered sub-item/cross-reference this example cites; B's own quote field was not a quote at all (it echoed the file's own title/caption). Re-derived directly from source-lines-1390-2934.txt, scoped to exactly the cited rule id.

corrections.note: Addendum 2.3.6e: new required reproduction notice, "Any further reproduction or distribution other than in an accessible format is an infringement," replacing the 2016 "Further reproduction or distribution in other than a specialized format is prohibited." Confirmed by the Addendum BRF and by liblouis. The second line is exactly 40 cells.

Gold regeneration from the PDF (Fable review recommendation 1): the K33 spacing audit (gold-spacing-audit/) never checked blank-line counts, since a text dump has no way to show a wholly blank line at all. This regenerates blank-line counts from the vertical gap between the book's own SimBraille text rows either side of the gap (gap in points divided by this box's own measured single-line pitch, rounded), which is unaffected by the earlier 2-cells-collapsed-to-1 text-dump bug. 1 delete.
